comment.description: Optional description of the Streamlit app, used for documentation or metadata purposes

imports.description: List of files to be imported from a stage.

external_access_integrations.description: List of external access integrations needed in order for the Streamlit app code to access external networks.

external_access_secrets.description: Secrets needed for the Streamlit app code to access external networks.

title.description: User-facing title of the Streamlit app.

main_file.description: Name and path of the entry file for the Streamlit app

query_warehouse.description: Warehouse used to run queries issued by the Streamlit app

default_version.description: The default version name of Streamlit. Valid values are "first" (first version), "last" (latest version), or "version$N" (specific version, e.g., "version$1"). Custom names are not supported.

created_on.description: Date and time when the Streamlit was created.

database_name.description: Database in which the Streamlit is stored

schema_name.description: Schema in which the Streamlit is stored

owner_role_type.description: The type of role that owns the Streamlit

source_location.description: The stage from which the source files are copied to initialize the Streamlit app.

url_id.description: A unique ID associated with the Streamlit object's URL.

default_packages.description: Default Python packages for Streamlit apps.

user_packages.description: Python packages specified in the environment.yml file.

live_version_location_uri.description: The location of the Streamlit object's live version files.
